ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in circle $O$, $\angle ACB=30^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle AOB$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that in circle $\odot O$, $\angle ACB=30^\circ$,\\
therefore, $\angle AOB=2\angle ACB=60^\circ$,\\
hence, the answer is: $\boxed{60^\circ}$.
